blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: What reusable units of computation can we discover within a language model's neurons? Prior work has shown that individual forward passes can often be sparsified post-hoc to small groups of neurons, but it has been unclear whether these groups form coherent computational entities reused across inputs. We introduce neuron community discovery, an unsupervised method for finding neuron groups that recur across prompts and are causally necessary and sufficient, within the layers they span, for common computations. The method combines gradient-based attribution, a graph connecting neurons that are repeatedly attributed together, and community detection. Applied to Llama-3.1-8B using ten million prompts, it discovers thousands of candidate communities. We evaluate them on held-out prompts through three causal tests: community necessity, sufficiency within a layer subset, and layer necessity. These tests identify groups whose removal disrupts predictions and whose retention preserves predictions despite ablating the remaining MLP neurons in the tested layers. Discovered communities support functions like grammatical agreement, token-probability calibration, fixed phrases, in-context copying, addition, and multiplication. With communities capped at 128 neurons across all layers, 10.3% of held-out prompts have at least one layer's contribution explained on a neuron-sparse basis. Coverage remains 8.7% when requiring at least four layers and 3.3% when requiring at least twelve. These results show that small groups of existing neurons can provide reusable computational components across prompts, and that such groups can be discovered at scale.

blocks.en: What are the basic units of computation in a language model? We would like to identify components of the model that consistently implement a certain function across different prompts. Ideally, this decomposition would reflect the model’s natural taxonomy of computations, and the building blocks would encode recurring patterns of model use. Existing techniques in interpretability make progress on parts of this goal. Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) learn a dictionary of reusable atoms directly from a heterogeneous corpus, but their training objective is to reconstruct a model’s activations rather than to capture its computation. Per-layer transcoders approximate MLP computation within a single layer.
blocks.zh: 语言模型中的基本计算单位是什么? 我们想确定该模式中始终如一地在不同提示中履行某种职能的组成部分。 理想的情况是,这种分解将反映模型的自然计算分类,构件将编码模型的反复使用模式。 可解释性方面的现有技术使这一目标的部分内容取得进展。 Sparse 自动编码器(SAEs)直接从一个异体中学习一个可再用原子的词典,但他们的训练目标是重建一个模型的活化,而不是捕捉它的计算. 每个层的转码器大约在一层内计算出MLP.

blocks.en: Attribution graphs built from cross-layer transcoder features trace computation across layers ( Ameisen et al., 2025 ; Lindsey et al., 2025 ) . Neuron-based circuits also show promise: Arora et al. (2026) show that neuron-based circuits can be as sparse and faithful as circuits built from sparse-autoencoder features on subject–verb agreement, and recover neuron groups involved in intermediate steps of multi-hop reasoning. Feucht et al. (2026) identify 28 neurons in layer 18 of Llama-3.1-8B that implement a base-10 addition mechanism reused across arithmetic tasks. Still, these analyses typically use small sets of human-selected prompts, implicitly assuming that the model’s computations follow human task categories.
blocks.zh: 由跨层转码器特征所构建的分层微量计算图(Ameisen等,2025;Lindsey等,2025)。 以神经为主的电路也显示出希望: Arora等人(2026年)表明,神经元基电路可以像由主题-动词协议上稀有的自发编码器特征所构建的电路一样稀少而忠实,并恢复参与多跳推理中间步骤的神经元组. Feucht等人(2026年)在Llama-3.1-8B的第18层中识别出28个神经元,这些神经元执行一个跨算术任务再用的基础-10添加机制. 然而,这些分析通常使用小套人类选定的提示,暗地中假设模型的计算符合人类任务类别。

blocks.en:
We reverse this approach: across millions of diverse prompts, we identify neuron groups repeatedly recruited together, then ask what computations they perform. This lets us discover recurring computational units without specifying their functions in advance.
We introduce neuron community discovery to make this search scalable. We use gradient-based attribution to identify influential neurons in Llama-3.1-8B across ten million prompts from FineWeb-Edu, Wikipedia, and FineMath. We connect neurons repeatedly attributed together in a graph and use Leiden community detection at multiple resolution thresholds to find candidate communities ( Figure 1 ).
We evaluate these communities through causal interventions on held-out prompts. A community is necessary when ablating its neurons substantially changes the next-token distribution. It is sufficient when retaining its neurons, while ablating the other MLP neurons in the same set of layers, largely preserves the distribution.
blocks.zh:
我们扭转了这个方法:在数百万个不同的提示中,我们发现神经元群体反复被招募在一起,然后问他们做了什么计算。 这样我们就可以发现反复出现的计算单位,而无需事先具体说明它们的功能.
我们引入了神经元群落的发现 使这次搜索可以扩展 我们用梯度属性来识别Llama-31-8B中具有影响力的神经元,这些神经元来自FineWeb-Edu,维基百科和FineMath,共有一千万个提示. 我们在图中将反复归属的神经元连接起来,并在多个分辨率阈值下使用莱顿社区检测来寻找候选社区(图1).
我们通过因果干预来评估这些社区。 当一个社区神经元的分泌大大地改变了接吻的分布时,它是必要的。 它在保留其神经元时就足够了,同时将其他的MLP神经元分解为同一组地层,基本上保持了分布.

blocks.en: As an example, one of the discovered communities is responsible for an + vowel agreement: six neurons across six layers promote words starting with a vowel after the article an . Removing these neurons substantially changes predictions on randomly sampled an -article prompts, with a median KL divergence of 4.99. Retaining these six neurons and four “always on” neurons while removing the remaining MLP computation in those six layers largely preserves the prediction, with a median KL divergence of 0.053. This illustrates how a small neuron group distributed across several layers can be necessary and sufficient for a common linguistic behavior.
blocks.zh: 例如,一个被发现的社区负责一个+元音协议:6个跨六层的神经元促进词从一个元音开始,在文章a后. 消除这些神经元会大大改变随机抽样的预测 -- -- 粒子提示,中位值为KL相差4.99。 保留这6个神经元和4个“总是”神经元,同时去除这6个层中剩余的MLP计算,在很大程度上保留了预测,中位KL相差为0.053. 这说明一个分布在多层的小神经元组群对于共同的语言行为是必要和足够的.

blocks.en: Our method discovers thousands of other communities with similar properties, supporting grammatical agreement, morphology, common expressions, formatting, in-context copying, and numerical operations. To measure how broadly these sparse explanations apply, we count unique held-out prompts for which at least one community passes causal tests. Pooling communities across six resolution thresholds covers 10.3% of prompts within at least one layer. Coverage remains 8.7% when we require at least four layers and 3.3% when we require at least twelve, using communities of at most 128 neurons. The most common behaviors are grammatical and token-level, such as calibrating token probabilities or completing fixed phrases. Other communities support more complex behaviors, including in-context copying, addition, and multiplication.
blocks.zh: 我们的方法发现了数千个具有类似属性的其他社区,支持语法协议,形态学,常见表达法,格式化,内文复制,和数字操作. 为了衡量这些稀少的解释适用的范围,我们计算出一个社区至少通过因果测试的独特被搁置的提示。 跨越6个分辨率阈值的集合社区覆盖至少一层内10.3%的电源。 使用最多128个神经元的社区,当我们至少需要4个层时,覆盖率仍然为8.7%,当我们至少需要12个层时,覆盖率为3.3%。 最常见的行为是语法和符号级,如校正符号概率或完成固定短语等. 其他社区支持更复杂的行为,包括内文复制,添加和相乘.

blocks.en: These communities form a useful dictionary of reusable neuron groups, covering a substantial fraction of prompts. Many prompts remain unexplained, potentially reflecting computations that are not neuron-sparse as well as limitations of discovery.
blocks.zh: 这些群落构成了可再使用的神经元群的有用词典,覆盖了相当一部分的突起. 许多提示仍然无法解释,可能反映非神经元分层的计算以及发现的局限性。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Circuits in language models. Sparse autoencoders learn interpretable features from activations ( Bricken et al., 2023 ) , while transcoders approximate MLP computation with sparsely activating features ( Dunefsky et al., 2024 ) . Using native MLP neurons and relevance patching (RelP), Arora et al. (2026) recover subject–verb agreement circuits comparable in sparsity and faithfulness to circuits built from sparse-autoencoder features. They also identify neuron groups supporting intermediate computations in multi-hop reasoning, addition, and multilingual antonyms.
blocks.zh: 语言模型中的电路. Sparse自定义编码器从活化中学习可解释特性(Bricken等,2023年),而转码器则以稀有活化特性相近的MLP计算(Dunefsky等,2024年). 使用原生的MLP神经元和相干补丁(RelP),Arora等 (2026年)恢复了以相干和忠实程度与由稀有自发编码器特征所构建的回路相匹配的主题-动词协议回路. 它们也识别了支持中间计算在多跳推理,加法,多语种杂指中的神经元组.

blocks.en: Explaining individual neurons. Prior work interprets MLP neurons as textual-pattern detectors that promote vocabulary items ( Geva et al., 2021 ) , and uses sparse probes to identify features represented by small neuron groups ( Gurnee et al., 2023 ) . Other studies identify token and n-gram detectors ( Voita et al., 2024 ) , neurons regulating prediction confidence and token-frequency preferences ( Stolfo et al., 2024 ) , and neuron families shared across independently trained GPT-2 models ( Gurnee et al., 2024 ) . These findings relate to the token-level behaviors we discover.
blocks.zh: 解释单个神经元. 先前的工作将MLP神经元解释为文字-平面检测器来宣传词汇项目(Geva等,2021年),并使用稀疏的探测器来识别由小神经元组代表的特征(Gurnee等,2023年). 其他研究查明了信使和正克探测器(Voita等,2024年),调节预测自信和信使频率偏好(Stolfo等,2024年)的神经元,以及跨独立培训的GPT-2模型共享的神经元家族(Gurnee等,2024年). 这些发现与我们发现的象征级行为有关.

blocks.en: Cammarata (2026) proposes that much apparent polysemanticity arises from recursive generalization across related patterns, providing the motivation for direct study of neurons and their circuits. Tigges et al. (2026) provide empirical evidence for sparse neuron computation in Qwen3.6-35B-A3B and use subcircuit analysis to characterize neurons’ computational roles, with concise descriptions that predict and simulate strong activations.
blocks.zh: Cammarata(2026年)提出,许多明显的多聚体抗异性产生于跨相关模式的递归通化,为直接研究神经元及其回路提供了动力. Tigges等 (中文(简体) ). (2026)为Qune3.6-35B-A3B中稀有的神经元计算提供了经验性证据,并用子电路分析来描述神经元的计算作用,并有能预测并模拟强活性的简洁描述.

blocks.en: Nikankin et al. (2025) identify sparse neuron sets implementing arithmetic heuristics, such as detecting operand ranges. Feucht et al. (2026) find 28 neurons in layer 18 of Llama-3.1-8B that perform base-10 addition in numerical tasks and questions about months, weekdays, and hours. These neurons group by Fourier features of different periods. Their reuse across tasks motivates our search for neuron groups supporting recurring behaviors.
blocks.zh: Nikankin等人(2025年)识别出执行算术heuristics的稀有神经元组,如探测可操作范围. Feucht等人 (2026年)在Llama-3.1-8B的第18层中发现了28个神经元,这些神经元在数值任务和问题中执行了10个基数,大约数月,平日,小时. 这些由不同时期的傅里叶特征所组成的神经元组. 它们跨任务重复使用 促使我们寻找神经元组 支持反复出现的行为

blocks.en: Automated circuit discovery. Automated methods identify model components responsible for a behavior ( Conmy et al., 2023 ; Kramár et al., 2024 ; Marks et al., 2025 ) . ACDC tests which connections can be removed without substantially changing a chosen behavior ( Conmy et al., 2023 ) . Marks et al. (2025) construct causal circuits from sparse-autoencoder features and introduce an unsupervised pipeline that discovers thousands of circuits and their associated behaviors, a close precedent for discovery at scale.
blocks.zh: 自动电路发现. 自动化方法确定对某种行为负责的模型组件(Conmy等,2023;Kramár等,2024;Marks等,2025)。 ACDC测试哪些连接可以在不实质性改变所选择的行为的情况下被去除(Conmy等,2023.). 马克斯等. (2025年)从稀有的自动编码器特性中构建出因果电路并引入了一条无监督的管道来发现上千个电路及其相关行为,这是大规模发现的近乎先例.

blocks.en: Given an input dataset, we first identify the top- k k most important neurons for each prompt using gradient-based attribution. We then discover communities of neurons that consistently co-occur in the top- k k sets across prompts. Finally, we test each neuron community causally on held-out data, asking whether the community is necessary and sufficient (within a certain subset of layers) for the prediction. Figure 1 summarizes the pipeline.

blocks.en: Step 2: Co-occurrence graph. We build an undirected graph whose nodes are MLP neurons. For each pair of nodes, we count how many prompts attribute both neurons. Raw co-occurrence is confounded by neuron popularity, since frequently attributed neurons will co-occur often even without a specific relationship. We therefore compute a z-score measuring how unusually high this count is given the nodes’ individual frequencies. We use this z-score as the edge weight and retain pairs that meet minimum count and z-score thresholds (see “Experimental Setup” below).

blocks.en:
Step 3: Community discovery. We use Leiden community detection ( Traag et al., 2019 ) with the Constant Potts Model objective, which allows us to search for small neuron communities at multiple resolution thresholds ( Traag et al., 2011 ) .
The resolution parameter γ \gamma controls granularity: smaller values produce larger communities, while larger values split the graph into finer groups.
Because no single resolution is appropriate for every mechanism, we run Leiden over a grid of γ \gamma values and pool the resulting communities together.
Additionally, we identify a set of “always on” neurons: those present in the top- k k most important neurons for more than 20% of prompts.

分辨率参数 γ\gamma 控制颗粒性:较小的值产生更大的群落,而较大的值将图分出更细的组.

blocks.en: 4.1 Case study: an + vowel agreement
blocks.zh: 4.1 国家 案例研究:一个+元音协议

blocks.en: We first examine one of the discovered communities responsible for an + vowel agreement. Of the 20,339 prompts on which the full discovered community passes the necessity and sufficiency tests, 99.7% end at an an token, always used as an article, rather than as a fragment within a word. Below we use “community active on a prompt” as shorthand to mean that a community passes sufficiency and necessity tests on that prompt.
blocks.zh: 我们首先检查一个发现的社区 负责一个+元音协议。 在被完全发现的社区通过必要性和充足性测试的20 339个提示中,99.7%以象征性方式结束,总是作为文章使用,而不是作为一个单词中的碎片。 下面我们用“即时活跃的社区”作为简称,表示一个社区在即时通过充分性和必要性测试。

blocks.en: To assess the community’s recall for this behavior, we sample 8,000 prompts ending in the article token ␣an independently of whether the community is active. We focus on the six community neurons in the L2–L14 subspan: L2 :5664 , L5 :3846 , L8 :13390 , L12 :14182 , L13 :3604 , and L14 :11888 . We test their necessity, sufficiency, and layer necessity, intervening only in these six layers and retaining the four “always on” neurons ( L2 :4786 , L5 :7012 , L12 :13860 , L13 :4208 ).
blocks.zh: 为了评估社区对这种行为的回忆, 我们抽取了8000个提示, 我们专注于L2–L14子板中的6个社区神经元:L2:5664,L5:3846,L8:13390,L12:14182,L13:3604,和L14:11888. 我们检验其必要性、充分性和层层必要性,只干预这六层,并保留四个“永远”的神经元(L2:4786;L5:7012;L12:13860;L13:4208)。

blocks.en: Removing the six community neurons substantially changes the model’s predictions (orange in Figure 2 ). The median KL divergence is 4.99. The mean absolute change in the probability of the clean top-1 token is 0.42, against a mean clean probability of 0.57. Removing all MLP neurons in the same six layers except the four “always on” neurons has a comparable effect (teal in Figure 2 ): the median KL divergence is 3.15, and the mean absolute probability change is 0.38. By comparison, ablating six randomly selected neurons leaves most predictions nearly unchanged, with KL divergence concentrated near zero (gray in Figure 2(a) ).
blocks.zh: 移除6个社区神经元会大大地改变模型的预测(图2中的橙色). KL中位相差为4.99. 清洁顶一号牌概率的平均绝对变化为0.42,而平均清洁概率为0.57. 除四个"永远"的神经元外,在同一六层中去除所有MLP神经元具有可比较的效果(图2中为:KL中位差为3.15,而平均绝对概率变化为0.38. 相较之下,随机抽取出6个神经元使大多数预测几乎保持不变,而KL的分量集中在接近于零(图2(a)中的灰色).

blocks.en: In contrast, keeping only the six community neurons, out of 86,016 total in those layers, along with the four “always on” neurons, largely preserves the prediction (purple in Figure 2 ). The KL distribution peaks below 0.1, with a median of 0.053. The mean absolute change in the clean top-1 token’s probability falls to 0.08. Thus, on most an-article prompts, these six neurons preserve the prediction despite removal of the remaining MLP computation in the corresponding six layers.
blocks.zh: 相比之下,在这些地层的86,016个神经元中,只有6个神经元与4个“永远”的神经元一样,基本上保留了预测(图2中的纯度)。 KL的分布峰值为0.1以下,中位数为0.053. 净上下1个符号的概率平均绝对变化为0.08. 因此,在大多数一粒子提示中,这六个神经元保留了预测,尽管在相应的六层中删除了剩余的MLP计算.

blocks.en: The small peak near zero KL under community ablation identifies prompts that are largely unaffected by the ablation, e.g. common expressions such as “to give you an [example]”.
blocks.zh: 在社区衰减下接近零KL的小峰会识别出基本上不受衰减影响的提示,例如常见的表达方式,如“给你一个[例 ”。

blocks.en: We examine how predictions change as increasing subsets of community neurons are removed in Section 6 . The community seem to operate mostly as a redundant voting of individual neurons: removing any one neuron does almost no damage, but removing several at once can starts to substantially disrupt the prediction.
blocks.zh: 我们研究了第6节中如何去除社区神经元中越来越多的子集的预测变化。 社区的运作似乎大多是单个神经元的冗余投票:去除任何一个神经元几乎不会造成损伤,但一次去除几个神经元就可以开始严重地扰乱预测.

blocks.en: 4.2 Representative behaviors
blocks.zh: 4.2 代表性行为

blocks.en: The an + vowel community is one of thousands discovered by our method. Table 1 illustrates their range of behaviors, spanning grammar, morphology, formatting, in-context lookup, numerical operations, and token-level operations. For each example, we report neuron and layer counts within the selected subspan, a representative prompt, and predictions before and after community ablation. An interactive explorer of the full collection is available at https://goodfire.com/demos/neuron-communities .
blocks.zh: 一个+元音群是用我们的方法发现的上千个元音群之一. 表1说明了它们的行为范围,包括语法,形态,格式,内文检索,数字操作,和符号级操作. 例如,我们报告所选子板内的神经元和分层计数,一个具有代表性的提示,以及社区衰竭前后的预测。 全集的交互式探险家可在https://goodfire.com/demos/neuron-communes上查阅。

blocks.en: Many discovered communities perform grammatical and morphological roles. A community of nine neurons across nine layers selects is or are after there : ablating it changes the prediction after “Ten cards are put into five envelopes so that there” from are to is . Another community detects the plural suffix -s ; removing it makes the model behave as though the preceding word were singular. Formatting communities support operations such as completing a LaTeX command or closing a parenthesis.
blocks.zh: 许多被发现的群落扮演了语法和形态角色. 由九层所选择的九个神经元组成的社区正在或正在之后:在“十张卡被放入五个信封”之后, 另一个社区检测到复数后缀 - s;去掉它使模型的行为像前一个单词一样. 格式化社区支持诸如完成一个 LaTeX 命令或关闭括号等操作.

blocks.en: Other communities support copying information from the context. Table 1 shows how ablating seven neurons prevents the model from retrieving the filename ( Delta.exe ) mentioned in the context and leads it to produce a generic continuation instead. Induction heads provide a known mechanism for copying continuations from context ( Olsson et al., 2022 ) . The community may work alongside such heads, although we have not tested that interaction.
blocks.zh: 其他社区支持从背景复制信息。 表1显示了七个神经元的分泌如何阻止模型取回上下文中提到的文件名(Delta.exe),并导致它产生通用续作. 上岗主管为从上下文复制续作提供了一个已知的机制(Olsson等,2022.)。 社区可以同这些领导人一道工作,尽管我们尚未检验这种互动。

blocks.en: Numerical communities support more complex computations. We recover an eight-neuron addition community that is necessary and sufficient on a range of addition prompts. A multiplication community supports multiplication and division across several settings: explicit arithmetic such as “2*8=”, the prime-factorization example in Table 1 , and unit conversion, e.g. a model predicting “68mi” following “112km (”.
blocks.zh: 数字社区支持更复杂的计算. 我们恢复了一个8个中微子加成社区,它对于一系列加成提示是必要和足够的. 乘法群落支持多处设置相乘和相分:如表1中的“2*8=”等显式算法;单位转换,如“112公里(.)后预测“68mi”的模型。

blocks.en: Many behaviors are token-level operations, including suppressing particular tokens and promoting common expressions such as each other or made up . These expression communities are sensitive to the intended continuation: the each other community promotes each only when it is used as a part of the phrase, but not in other contexts. Another community consistently reduces the probability of the token fraction .
blocks.zh: 许多行为都是象征级的操作,包括压制特定指使并相互推广或编造出共同的表达. . 这些表达社区对预期的续作很敏感:彼此社区只有在作为短语的一部分使用时才会互相促进,但在其他情况下则不会. 另一社区则持续减少象征分数的概率。

blocks.en: Most communities we inspect have similarly consistent effects across their associated prompts. Figure 3 shows a broader view of community size and layer distribution. Each point represents a community, with the y-axis representing the number of neurons in that community and the x-axis representing the number of layers these neurons come from. A larger circle indicates a community with more prompts for which it passes the causal tests. The figure shows a subsample of 1,000 communities, randomly sampled at the prompt level. The densest region contains communities with fewer than ten neurons across two or three layers, often supporting token-level operations and common expressions. Other displayed communities extend across roughly 15 layers, showing that a small neuron set can participate in computations distributed across much of the model.
blocks.zh: 我们所检查的大多数社区,在它们相关的提示中,也具有同样一致的效果。 图3显示社区规模和地层分布的更广阔观点。 每个点代表一个群落,Y轴代表该群落中的神经元数量,而x轴代表这些神经元的地层数量. 一个更大的圆圈表示一个社区,它拥有更多的提示,通过因果测试。 图中显示有1000个社区的子样本,随机抽取到即时水平. 密度最大的区域包含两至三层神经元不足10个的社区,常支持符号级操作和常见表达. 其他被显示的群落延伸了大约15个地层,表明一个小的神经元集合可以参与分布在模型大部分部分的计算.

blocks.zh: 5 覆盖范围

blocks.en: 5.1 Prompt coverage
blocks.zh: 5.1 迅速覆盖

blocks.en: We now quantify how often the discovered communities explain the model’s predictions. We run graph partitioning at six resolution thresholds, γ ∈ { 32 , 64 , 128 , 256 , 512 , 1024 } \gamma\in\{32,64,128,256,512,1024\} , each producing its own set of communities. These sets can overlap in both their neurons and the behaviors they support, but searching multiple thresholds recovers communities that are missed at any single threshold.
blocks.zh: 现在,我们量化了被发现的族群如何经常解释模型的预测。 我们按六个分辨率阈值进行图分, QQ {32, 64, 128, 256, 512, 1024}\gamma\in 32, 64, 128, 256, 512, 1024} , 各产生自己的社区。 这些集合既可以在它们的神经元中和它们支持的行为中相重叠,但搜索多个阈值会恢复在任何单个阈值被忽略的社区.

blocks.en: Under the least restrictive definition, a prompt is explained by a neuron-sparse community if at least one layer’s contribution can be explained by community neurons, with all three causal tests passing: necessity, sufficiency, and layer necessity. Here, “explained” is shorthand for a partial explanation of the prediction, where a community explains the contribution of certain layers to the final model prediction. Figure 4(a) shows the proportion of unique prompts covered for each resolution threshold and for their union. Communities are added greedily, choosing the community that explains the most previously uncovered prompts at each step. At γ = 256 \gamma=256 , only ten communities cover approximately 1.5% of prompts, including behaviors such as the an + vowel agreement examined in Section 4.1 . Pooling communities across all six thresholds increases coverage to 10.3%: for roughly one in ten prompts, we find a neuron-sparse community that is necessary and sufficient within at least one layer – the random baseline only achieves  3% in the same setup (( Appendix B )).
blocks.zh: 在最小的限制性定义下,如果至少有一层神经元能解释出一个神经分层的活性,那么一个神经分层的活性就会被一个神经分层群落所解释,所有三个因果测试都会通过:必要性、充足性和分层必要性。 这里,“解释”是对预测的部分解释的简写,其中社区解释某些层次对最后模型预测的贡献。 图4(a)显示每个决议阈值及其结合所覆盖的独特提示的比例。 社区被贪婪地加入其中,选择一个社区来解释以前每个步骤中发现的最突出的提示。 在γ = 256\gamma= 256时,只有10个社区覆盖了大约1.5%的提示,包括第4.1节所审查的多元音协议等行为. 跨越所有六个阈值的集合社区将覆盖率提高到10.3%:我们发现大约十分之一的神经分裂社区在至少一层内是必要和充分的,随机基线在同一结构中只达到3%((附录B))。

blocks.en: Figure 4(b) shows the coverage for explanations involving several layers. A prompt counts at threshold L L if a single community found at any γ \gamma passes all three causal tests within the same set of at least L L distinct layers (which need not be contiguous). Coverage remains high at 8.7% for L ≥ 4 L\geq 4 and 3.3% for L ≥ 12 L\geq 12 . Thus, individual sparse communities can explain contributions from several layers simultaneously.
blocks.zh: 图4(b)显示了涉及多层的解释范围。 如果在任何 γ\gamma 中发现的单个群落通过至少L L 个分层的同一组内的所有三个因果测试(不需要毗连),则在L L 下立即计数。 覆盖率仍然很高,L 4 L\克为8.7%,L 12 L\克为3.3%。 因此,个别人口稀少的社区可以同时解释几个层面的贡献。

blocks.en: In the experiments so far, we have set a sparsity threshold of 128 neurons across all layers. Figure 4(c) varies this arbitrary threshold, while retaining the same causal criteria. Communities with at most 16 neurons already explain at least one layer on approximately 6.7% of prompts, showing that substantial coverage persists under a much tighter neuron budget.
blocks.zh: 在迄今为止的实验中,我们已经设定了一个跨出各层128个神经元的孢子阈值. 图4(c)改变了这种任意的阈值,同时保留同样的因果标准。 拥有最多16个神经元的社区已经对大约6.7%的电极至少一层作了解释,表明在更紧的神经元预算下,覆盖范围仍然很大。

blocks.en: 5.2 Behavioral taxonomy
blocks.zh: 5.2 行为分类学

blocks.en: Table 2: Frequency of neuron-sparse behaviors and associated communities, as classified by an auto-interp pipeline with gpt-5.6-terra .
blocks.zh: 表2:神经元分裂行为和相关群落的频率,按照有gpt-5.6-terra的自动干扰管分类.

blocks.en: To characterize the behaviors represented by the discovered communities, we use an LLM to describe and classify communities found at γ = 256 \gamma=256 that pass the causal tests on at least 10 held-out prompts. For each community, we provide gpt-5.6-terra with up to 100 prompts where the community is necessary and sufficient, together with the model’s predictions before and after community ablation, and the ground truth. The LLM assigns one primary label from a manually created taxonomy of eight broad classes in Table 2 . Appendix E provides the classifier prompt, taxonomy, and an example input.
blocks.zh: 为了描述被发现社区所代表的行为,我们使用LLM来描述和分类在γ = 256\gamma= 256中发现的社区,这些社区通过至少10个被搁置的提示的因果关系测试。 对每个社区来说,我们向gpt-5.6-terra提供最多100个提示,只要社区是必要和充分的,同时提供模型在社区衰竭前后的预测,以及地面真相。 LLM 从表2中由8个大类组成的手工创建的分类中指定一个主标签 。 附 录 E提供了分类器即时,分类学,以及示例输入.

blocks.en: Lexical behaviors, such as completing common phrases like make up , form the largest class, accounting for 42.3% of communities and covering 31.3% of prompts explained by at least one classified community. Per-token probability calibration, such as suppressing a fixed word, e.g. fraction , accounts for another 19.5% of communities. Community counts and prompt coverage differ substantially across classes: grammar and agreement, such as an + vowel agreement or singular/plural agreement, comprise only 2.9% of communities but cover 15.3% of these covered prompts. Topic-related communities, such as those promoting vocabulary about football or abstract algebra, comprise 9.0% of communities and cover 3.0% of prompts. These results distinguish frequently discovered behaviors from those that apply broadly across prompts.
blocks.zh: 语法行为,例如完成像组成这样的常见短语,组成了最大的类,占社区总数的42.3%,覆盖至少一个分类社区解释的31.3%的提示. 偶发概率校正,例如压制固定的单词,如分数,占另外19.5%的社区。 社区计数和即时覆盖在不同的类别中差别很大:语法和协议,如+元音协议或单数/多数协议,仅占社区总数的2.9%,但涵盖15.3%。 与主题有关的社区,如推广足球或抽象代数词汇的社区,占社区总数的9.0%,占3.0%。 这些结果将经常发现的行为与广泛适用于各种提示的行为区分开来。

blocks.en:
Figure 5 shows how the neurons in each behavior are distributed across layers. Prior work also finds differences with depth in the textual patterns detected by MLP neurons ( Geva et al., 2021 ) .
Per-token suppression/promotion, for instance, is concentrated in the latest layers. Sub-word completion peaks at L0, with a secondary peak around L15–L17. Grammar is more concentrated from L18 onward, while retrieval and computation, including numerical operations, peak around L17–L22.

图5显示每种行为的神经元如何分层分布. 前作还发现由MLP神经元检测到的文字图案深度不同(Geva等,2021年).
例如,一脚一脚的抑制/促进集中在最近一层。 子词完成高峰为L0,二级高峰为L15-L17左右. 语法从L18向上比较集中,而检索和计算,包括数字操作,则在L17–L22左右达到高峰.

blocks.en: Figure 5 : Different behaviors rely on neurons at different depths. Each row shows the distribution across layers of neurons in communities assigned to a given behavioral class.
blocks.zh: 图5:不同行为依赖于不同深度的神经元. 每行显示分配到特定行为类群落中神经元的分层分布.

blocks.en: 6 Community deep dive
blocks.zh: 6个社区深潜

blocks.en: To examine how neurons within a discovered community work together, we return to the six-neuron an + vowel community from Section 4.1 , using 100 randomly sampled prompts on which it passes the necessity and sufficiency tests. We start from the community-only intervention: in its six layers we ablate all MLP neurons except the community members and the “always on” neurons. We then evaluate all 2 6 = 64 2^{6}=64 subsets of retained community members, keeping the “always on” neurons always active. For each subset, we measure the mean KL divergence from the clean next-token distribution.
blocks.zh: 为了检查一个被发现的社区内部的神经元是如何合作的, 我们从第4.1节返回到一个+元音的六中子, 使用100个随机抽取的提示, 通过必要性和充分性测试。 我们从只有社区的干预开始:在它的六层中,除了社区成员和“永远”的神经元之外,我们把所有的MLP神经元都消退。 然后,我们评估所有2 6 = 64 2 = 6 = 6 = 6 = 64 个保留社区成员的子集,保持“永远”神经元的活性。 对于每个子集,我们测量 KL 与干净的相邻分布的正差 。

blocks.en: L14:11888 alone recovers most of the community’s behavior: retaining it alone gives a KL divergence of 0.68 compared to 4.56 when all six community members are removed and 0.06 when all six are present. Adding L5:3846 reduces KL further to 0.07, producing almost identical behavior to the full community. L5:3846 is not a unique partner for L14:11888 : among the two-neuron subsets (four members removed), four of the five subsets containing L14:11888 achieve KL below 0.5 ( Figure 6 a). Several neurons can therefore complement its contribution.
blocks.zh: 仅L14:11888就恢复了社区的大部分行为:仅保留它就产生了0.68KL的相差,而当所有6个社区成员被删除时,只有0.06个。 加入L5:3846将KL进一步降低到0.07,产生出与全社区几乎相同的行为. L5:3846并不是L14:11888的独有合作伙伴: 在双中微子集(去除4个成员)中,包含L14:11888的5个子集中的4个实现KL低于0.5(图6 a). 因此,几个神经元可以补充它的贡献.

blocks.en: This community shows strong redundancy across its member neurons. Despite its strong effect in isolation, removing L14:11888 from the full community barely changes the prediction. Indeed, all six single-neuron ablations leave mean KL between 0.06 and 0.07, showing that the community tolerates losing any one member on these prompts ( Figure 6 a). Larger removals reveal differences between members: removing both L14:11888 and L5:3846 gives a KL divergence of 0.65, and additionally removing L12:14182 raises it to 2.20 ( Figure 6 b).
blocks.zh: 这个社区在成员神经元上表现出强烈的冗余. 尽管在隔离中产生了强烈的影响,将L14:11888从整个社区中移除,但几乎没有改变预测. 实际上,所有6个单中微子喷发都意味着0.06至0.07之间的KL,表明社区容忍在这些提示上失去任何一名成员(图6a)。 较大清除量显示出成员之间的差异:去除L14:11888和L5:3846两者的KL差值为0.65,另外去除L12:14182将其提高到2.20(图6b)。

blocks.en: Compensating for the loss of L14:11888 does not require all five other members. Retaining just L5:3846 and L12:14182 gives a KL divergence of approximately 0.2, corresponding to a point without a black border at four members removed. This pair matches or improves on pairs combining L14:11888 with L2:5664 , L12:14182 , or L13:3604 . Thus, the strongest neuron in isolation is replaceable even within a small subset of the community.
blocks.zh: 赔偿L14:11888损失并不要求其他5名成员全部。 仅保留了L5:3846和L12:14182的KL相差约0.2分,相当于一个没有黑色边界的点被移除了4个成员. 这种配对与L14:11888和L2:5664,L12:14182,或L13:3604结合的配对相匹配或改进. 因此,隔离中最强的神经元甚至可以在小群落中被取代.

blocks.en: For this community, the results suggest a form of redundant voting : neurons make unequal but partly substitutable contributions to a common behavior. Multiple combinations preserve the prediction, allowing the community to tolerate individual failures even though removing several complementary members can substantially disrupt it. This also shows why necessity of a community as a group does not imply necessity of each member.
blocks.zh: 对这个社群来说,结果暗示了一种冗余投票的形式:神经元对共同行为做出不平等但部分可以替代的贡献. 多种组合保留了预测,使社区能够容忍个别的失败,即使移除几个互补成员会严重扰乱预测。 这也表明为什么一个社区作为一个群体的必要性并不意味着每个成员的必要性。

blocks.en: The degree of redundancy varies across communities, as the additional subset ablations in Appendix F show. In the in-context copying community, removing L23:6134 alone raises mean KL divergence from 0.05 to 7.37, showing that a single member can be critical to a community’s effect.
blocks.zh: 各社区冗余程度各有不同,附录F中的额外子集显示. 在内容复制社区,仅删除L23:6134就会导致KL从0.05到7:37之间的差值,表明单个成员可能对社区的效果至关重要。

blocks.en: 7 Discussion and limitations
blocks.zh: 7. 讨论和限制

blocks.en: Neuron-sparse behaviors. Although we do not investigate why training produces neuron-sparse representations for some behaviors but not others, our results suggest a possible explanation. Allocating a small neuron group to a particular function carries a capacity cost, which could be offset by benefits for frequently used computations requiring precise answers, such as grammatical agreement, list formatting, or closing parentheses. We speculate that concentrating these computations in small neuron groups may help reduce interference from other functions. Our experiments do not directly test this explanation, and frequent behaviors are also easier for our pipeline to discover.
blocks.zh: 神经分裂行为 虽然我们不调查为何训练会对某些行为产生神经分裂症状,而对其他行为则不会产生神经分裂症状,但我们的结果表明可能的解释。 将一个小的神经元组分配到某个特定的函数上,会产生能力成本,而这种成本可以被需要精确答案的常用计算的好处所抵消,如语法协议,列表格式化,或收尾括号等. 我们推测将这些计算集中在小神经元组中可能有助于减少来自其他函数的干扰. 我们的实验并不直接测试这个解释,频繁的行为也更容易被我们的管道发现.

blocks.en: Figure 6 : Partial redundancy within the an + vowel community. Starting from the community-only intervention, we ablate every subset of its six members. (a) shows mean KL divergence for all possible combinations of removed member neurons. Black outlines mark runs where L14:11888 is retained. (b, c) show subsets with the highest and lowest KL at each number of members removed. Dots indicate retained neurons.
blocks.zh: 图6:一个+元音群内部的部分冗余. 从只有社区的干预开始,我们放弃其六名成员中的每一个子集。 (a) 显示所有可能的被移除成员神经元组合的KL差值。 黑色轮廓标记运行于保留L14:11888的地方. (b,c) 在去除的每个成员数目上显示KL最高和最低的子集. 点表示保留了神经元.

blocks.en: Behavior recall and interpretation. Measuring recall requires defining a behavior and testing diverse prompts to distinguish broad coverage from narrow template matching. Unlike an + vowel agreement, many behaviors have unclear boundaries and require manual inspection that is hard to scale. Automated interpretation may overlook inconsistencies; Huang et al. (2023) document observational and causal errors in generated neuron explanations. Our coverage measurements ( Section 5.1 ) therefore provide quantitative evidence for neuron-sparse behaviors, while the taxonomy ( Section 5.2 ) only illustrates possible functions: its labels may be inaccurate or overly broad.
blocks.zh: 行为召回并诠. 衡量召回需要定义一种行为并测试不同的提示,以区分广泛的覆盖范围和狭窄的模板匹配. 与一个+元音协议不同,许多行为有不明确的边界,需要人工检查,这很难衡量. 自动解释可能忽略了不一致之处;而黄等人(2023年)则记录了生成的神经元解释中的观测和因果错误. 因此,我们的覆盖范围测量(第5.1节)为神经分裂行为提供了定量证据,而分类学(第5.2节)仅说明了可能的功能:其标签可能不准确或过于宽泛。

blocks.en: Undiscovered behaviors. Failure to discover a community does not establish that a behavior lacks a neuron-sparse mechanism. A mechanism may be missed because the discovery data contain too few relevant prompts, because attribution does not reliably identify its neurons, or because graph partitioning fails to group them together. We find community discovery to be sensitive to the data used to construct the graph, as well as to the resolution threshold. Our measured coverage therefore describes the communities recovered by this pipeline on the evaluation distribution. It does not establish an upper limit on how much of the model’s behavior admits neuron-sparse explanations.
blocks.zh: 未发现的行为. 未能发现一个群体并不能证实某一行为缺乏神经元-分泌机制. 可能错失一个机制,因为发现数据中包含的关联提示太少,因为归属无法可靠地识别出其神经元,或者由于图分解未能将它们组合在一起. 我们认为社区发现对用于构建图表的数据以及分辨率阈值很敏感。 因此,我们所衡量的覆盖面描述了通过这一管道在评价分配上恢复的社区。 它并没有对模型行为中有多少能接受神经分泌解释设定上限.

blocks.en: Final token position. We restrict attribution and interventions to the final prompt position only. This will inevitably miss communities that operate across multiple positions. For instance, in the arithmetic example "2+5=", some neurons might read the operands at earlier positions, and other neurons would read it at the final position to perform the addition. The current version of our method would not be able to find these connections. We see this approach as a reasonable first step, which allowed us to ignore the complexities associated with cross-position communities; we believe extending community discovery to cross-position setup is an important direction for future research.
blocks.zh: 最后的标志位置。 我们把归属和干预仅限于最后的迅速立场。 这将不可避免地失去跨多个阵地运作的社区。 例如,在算术上的例子"2+5="中,一些神经元可能会在更早的位置读取操作符,而其他神经元会在最后的位置读取来进行附加. 目前我们的方法版本将无法找到这些连接. 我们认为这种方法是合理的第一步,它使我们能够忽视交叉位置社区的复杂性;我们认为,将社区发现扩大到交叉位置结构是未来研究的一个重要方向。

blocks.en: Non-overlapping communities. At each resolution threshold, Leiden partitions the graph into disjoint communities, assigning each neuron to only one group. A neuron may, however, participate in several mechanisms, so this constraint need not reflect the model’s organization. It can separate neurons that work together or force a shared neuron into only one of the groups that use it. Pooling communities across resolutions allows some overlap between candidate groups, but each individual partition retains this restriction. Allowing overlapping communities is a natural direction for extending the discovery method.
blocks.zh: 不相重叠的社区。 在每个分辨率阈值上,莱顿将图分解成分解群落,将每个神经元分配到一个组. 然而,神经元可能参与若干机制,因此这种制约不必反映模型的组织。 它可以将共同工作的神经元分出,或者强迫一个共享的神经元只分入使用它的一个组. 将各个社区汇集在各种决议中,可以使候选群体之间产生一些重叠,但每个群体都保留这一限制。 允许重叠群落是扩展发现方法的自然方向.

blocks.en: Internal organization of communities. Understanding how neuron community members work together is an important direction for future work. The subset ablations in Section 6 provide an initial view: the an + vowel community contains several small combinations that preserve its effect, consistent with redundant voting. We expect discovered communities to represent different forms of functional objects. Some may form circuits in which distinct neurons perform successive computational steps, while others may repeatedly reinforce one or two shared directions across layers, providing redundancy around a simpler computation. Community discovery provides candidate groups for these analyses. The ablations in Section 6 are only the first step toward characterizing their mechanisms.
blocks.zh: 社区内部组织。 了解神经元社区成员如何合作是未来工作的重要方向. 第6节中的子集分集提供了初始视图:一个+元音群包含几个小组合来保持其效果,与冗余投票一致. 我们期望发现的群落代表不同形式的功能物体. 有些可能形成电路,不同的神经元在其中连续进行计算步骤,而另一些可能反复地加强一到两个共同的地层方向,为更简单的计算提供了冗余. 社区发现为这些分析提供了候选群体。 第6节中的内容只是确定其机制特征的第一步。

blocks.en: 8 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 8 结论

blocks.en: We introduced neuron community discovery, a method for finding small groups of neurons that support common computations without specifying the behaviors in advance. In Llama-3.1-8B, the method discovers thousands of communities, with groups of at most 128 neurons passing our necessity and sufficiency tests within at least one layer on 10.3% of held-out prompts. Examples range from grammatical agreement and fixed phrases to copying and arithmetic. These results support small neuron groups as reusable units of computation in language models for at least some behaviors.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了神经元群落发现,一种寻找小群神经元的方法,这些神经元支持常见的计算,而不事先说明行为. 在Llama-3.1-8B中,这个方法发现了上千个社区, 最多有128个神经元的组在至少10.3%的被搁置的提示上在一层内通过我们的必需和充足性测试。 例子从语法协议和固定短语到复制和算术. 这些结果支持小神经元组作为语言模型中至少一些行为的可再用计算单位.

blocks.en: Appendix A Recovering known arithmetic neurons
blocks.zh: 附录A 恢复已知算术神经元

blocks.en: Feucht et al. [2026] identified 28 MLP neurons in layer 18 of Llama-3.1-8B that implement a base-10 addition mechanism reused across numerical addition and questions about hours, months, and weekdays. Starting from predefined arithmetic tasks, they use distributed alignment search to learn causal subspaces, then select neurons whose output weights align strongly with the learned output subspaces. We hypothesize that many behaviors in language models are similarly neuron-sparse , i.e. they are mediated by small groups of neurons. In this work we aim to develop a method that can discover such groups at scale, without specifying the behaviors in advance. As a first test, we ask whether inexpensive gradient-based attribution can recover the neurons selected by this subspace analysis.
blocks.zh: Feucht等人 [2026] 在Llama-3.1-8B 第18层确定了28个MLP神经元,该神经元在数字添加和提问中实施一个基-10再用机制,大约在数小时、数月和数个工作日。 从预定义的算术任务开始,他们使用分布式对齐搜索来学习因果子空间,然后选择其输出权重与所学输出子空间紧密相通的神经元. 我们假设语言模型中的许多行为 类似神经元-sparse, 即它们被小群神经元所调解。 在这项工作中,我们的目标是开发一种能够大规模发现这类群体的方法,而不事先具体说明其行为. 作为第一个测试,我们询问,基于梯度的廉价归属能否恢复本子空间分析所选择的神经元.

blocks.en: Figure 7 shows the top 40 neurons ranked by mean attribution for each template, with known neurons marked by black dots. The gradient-based attribution recovered 17/28 (60.7%) reference neurons for addition, 20/26 (76.9%) for hours, 13/16 (81.3%) for months, and 14/15 (93.3%) for weekdays. This recovery motivates using gradient attribution to identify candidate neuron groups across a broader corpus, followed by direct causal tests.

blocks.en: Appendix B Attribution method ablation
blocks.zh: 附录B 分配方法

blocks.en: We compare eight neuron-scoring methods and a shuffled-community baseline in a separate experiment at the one-million-prompt scale ( Figure 8 ). Each scoring method selects the top five neurons per layer at the prediction position. We discover communities over L0–L29, retain groups of 2–128 neurons, and pool and deduplicate them across the tested Leiden resolution thresholds. We measure coverage on the same 852,263 FineWeb-Edu, Wikipedia, and FineMath prompts shared by all runs. Communities are added greedily: each next community explains the largest number of previously unexplained prompts. All eight scoring methods and the shuffled-community baseline use the same three intervention tests and thresholds: a prompt is counted once if a community passes community necessity and layer necessity ( D KL ≥ 0.7 D_{\mathrm{KL}}\geq 0.7 ) and sufficiency ( D KL ≤ 0.2 D_{\mathrm{KL}}\leq 0.2 ), with all three interventions applied within the same tested layer subset.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了8个神经元评分法和在100万个瞬间尺度的单独实验中被洗涤的社区基线(图8)。 每个得分法在预测位置上每层选择前5个神经元. 我们发现L0-L29以上的群落,保留2-128个神经元组群,并汇集和复制这些神经元,跨越测试的莱顿分辨率阈值。 维基百科的FineWeb-Edu 和 FineMath 的同为所有运行共享的提示。 社区被贪婪地添加:下一个社区解释以前没有解释的提示数量最多。 所有8个评分法和被洗牌社区基线都使用相同的3个干预测试和阈值:如果一个社区通过社区必要性和地层必要性(DKL 0.7 D_{\mathrm{KL}}\geq 0.7)和充分性(DKL 0.2 D_{\mathrm{KL}}\leq 0.2),所有3个干预都在同一被测试地层子集内被应用,那么即算出一次.

blocks.en: All runs in this comparison also use the same set of “always on” neurons. blocks.zh: E.2 分类系统迅速

blocks.en: You classify a "neuron community" of Llama-3.1-8B by the FUNCTION it performs at the next-token prediction it controls. You get the community’s size and layers and up to 100 real examples: the text before the target (ending where the model predicts the next token), the actual next token, the model’s top predictions with probabilities, and the top predictions after the community’s neurons are removed at that position ("removed"). The community is causally necessary and sufficient on these examples. Look at what changes between the intact and removed predictions, not at the topic of the text. Assign exactly one PRIMARY label (the number), an optional SECONDARY label when a second reading is genuinely plausible, and a short lowercase FUNCTION slug naming the mechanism so that identical mechanisms get identical slugs across communities. LABELS 1 fixed phrase / collocation — one lexical trigger completes ONE fixed multiword expression or idiom tail ("each other", "from time to time", "take into account", "on behalf of"). *The completed string is the same across examples.* 2 specific token promoted after a trigger family — one output token promoted after a family of related triggers (" of" after ability/protection, " in" after increase/rise, "along" after come/happen, "exhibit" in museum contexts). *Same output token, different triggers, and the trigger motivates it.* 3 suppression of a default word — the community holds down one ordinary, topically plausible word or word family; when it is removed the prediction collapses onto that word in nearly every example, even where it is wrong (salt, budget, trust, bacteria, engine, wise, cup). *Look at the REMOVED column: it repeats one token at 0.6–1.0 across unrelated contexts.* 4 local grammar (closed-set choice) — syntactic choice decided by adjacent words: a/an, there is/are, do-support, subject–auxiliary inversion, article after a preposition, which/that, imperative after a fronted clause. *Antecedent is within a few tokens.* 5 long-range agreement / anaphora — form fixed by an earlier noun phrase or discourse referent: pronoun case/gender/number, possessive determiners (your/their/his), reflexives, copula number with an inverted or distant subject, VP-ellipsis auxiliary echo, polarity items licensed a clause earlier. *Antecedent is a sentence or more away.* 6 trigger lemma selects its complement — one recurring trigger word or lemma, several acceptable continuations chosen by local context: verb/noun argument structure (demand → \rightarrow of/for/to; "within" → \rightarrow the/a/weeks), sense-dependent continuation of a polysemous word (bank, interest, stress), compound heads after a fixed modifier (full-, run-). *Same trigger, output token varies.* 7 semantic content word / near-synonym choice — a specific content word required by sentence meaning, or the choice among a small set of near-synonyms for one role (" World" before War, "dedicated" for a church, victim/subject/target, end/goal/aim). *One lemma or one semantic role per community; the word is demanded, not merely on-topic.* 8 number / arithmetic / units — computed or scale-dependent numeric output: ordinal suffix from digits, digit continuation to the right precision, base conversion, exponent/sign continuation, Roman numerals, unit of the right magnitude, era markers, multiplicative comparison 9 punctuation / delimiter / layout in prose — delimiter and layout tokens in ordinary text: closing parenthesis/quote balance, what follows an opening bracket, resuming a clause after a parenthetical, list commas and dashes, em-dash continuation, periods after abbreviations, en dash vs hyphen in ranges, casing style 10 semantic formatting — structured values whose content matters: dates and citation digits, price/currency numerals, postcodes, phone numbers, time zones, e-mail local parts, call-sign suffixes, credentials after a name, the `@` sigil in handles 11 morphology / inflection choice — inflection or derivational variant of a word already started or determined: -ed vs -ing, plural -s/-es, possessive ’s, -ic/-ical/-ics, -ise/-ize, -driven/-based, generational suffix (Jr., III). *Alternatives are genuine variants of one word.* 12 stem completion of common words — finishing a split common word or Latinate root into whichever word follows (arch- → \rightarrow archives/archaic, dis-, aut(o)-, fresh-, contribut-, colo(u)r-), contractions (didn → \rightarrow ’t). *The fragment is a common-word stem and the completions are unrelated whole words.* 13 in-context copy — repeating a name, acronym, term or attribute that appears earlier in the prompt (vocatives, acronym expansion, title copy, a Wikipedia category attribute repeated from an adjacent line). *The string is present nearby.* 14 enumeration / sequence continuation — next item of an established series: next letter or number label, ordinal computed from listed items, ellipsis after a pattern, sequel numbering 15 code & markup syntax — programming/markup tokens governed by earlier code, including whitespace inside code: comment markers (// # /*), `$` and `&` sigils and operators, `()` on calls, closing HTML tag, type after `:`/`->`, SQL keywords, print statement of the language, LaTeX commands and brace balance, indentation width and column alignment in source, CLI subcommands, license headers inside code comments 16 non-English-specific grammar or script — mechanisms with no English counterpart: case-governed articles/pronouns/clitics (den/der, ihm/ihn, le/lo), governed prepositions in other languages (Spanish personal "a", Russian "при", French "à"), native script after a language label, the copula/connective/addressing formula opening a translated sentence (Es, Deshalb, Bien que, Se~nor Presidente). *If the same mechanism exists in English (e.g. lead → \rightarrow to / к / \CJKchar "52"30 , pronoun agreement in Spanish), label the MECHANISM (4/5/6/…) and put 16 as secondary.* 17 factual / world-knowledge recall — fills an entity slot from parametric knowledge and the entity changes with the question: US presidents from a clue, composer of an opera, band or singer of a song, sports record holders, actor for a role, publisher/co-author in a citation, "Hurricane ___" names. *The answer is not in the context.* 18 topic / semantic-field vocabulary — promotes the vocabulary of one domain rather than a specific token or role: drinks, waste, monasteries, football leagues, ophthalmology, abstract algebra, a region’s place names. *No single lemma dominates; removed predictions stay domain-plausible.* Last resort before 22/0. 19 context-independent token bias — pushes one token or short subword across contexts that share NO motivating trigger family, and is often wrong: function words (" the", " in", " of", "if", "by", "just"), first subwords (" D", " W", "wh", "Pre-"), digits ("0", "1", "18"), a default entity ("China"). *Two conditions, both required: the INTACT column shows the token even where wrong, AND the contexts have nothing in common that would call for it. A token over-applied inside its own family ("refer" in medical case handling, "high" in degree/scale phrases, "base" after customer/fan/home, "next" in sequencing phrases) is 2, not 19, even when it is sometimes wrong.* 20 proper-noun fragment completion — finishing a split name, place, acronym or taxon by orthography: letter/prefix hubs (B-, St-, L-, Sal-, Kn-), surname endings by script or region (Korean, Scandinavian, Basque, Hispanic "y", Hebrew, Indian, Sri Lankan), all-caps acronyms in parentheses, taxonomic binomials. *The fragment is a proper noun; nothing semantic is shared beyond the letters.* 21 template / boilerplate continuation — continuing a memorised document or site template rather than general prose structure: Wikipedia section headers and category lines ("Living people", "[Nationality] footballers", "-language films"), infobox and citation templates, forum and site chrome ("GMAT Club", "tutors are online", "Read Also"), copyright/license text in prose, the blank or leading-space token before a template entry. *The same near-verbatim template recurs across examples.* 22 trigger detector with heterogeneous effect — fires whenever one specific whole word or lemma appears (under/unter/под, format, name, volunteer, "3"), but the downstream tokens are neither completions of it nor its complements, and no single output pattern holds. *Use only after excluding 6, 12 and 20: if the outputs complete the trigger fragment into words or names (Red → \rightarrow giant/planet/Reda, Be → \rightarrow asts/atus/ings) it is 20 or 12; if they are the trigger word’s own continuation slot (Future → \rightarrow spouses/injury/Studies, bank → \rightarrow of/established, hear → \rightarrow to/these) it is 6. "Varied outputs" alone is never enough for 22.* Distinct from 0 (no shared trigger either). 0 other / unclear — no shared trigger and no shared effect after reading all examples (mixed content-word swaps, mixed digits/punctuation); describe what is seen PRECEDENCE 1. **3 vs 19 vs 2 (which column carries the shared token?)** REMOVED repeats one token everywhere → \rightarrow 3. INTACT shows the token, and the contexts share a motivating trigger family (a domain, a construction, a collocation set) → \rightarrow 2, even if the token is sometimes wrong. INTACT shows the token with no motivating family at all → \rightarrow 19. 2. **1 vs 2 vs 6 (what is fixed?)** fixed multiword string → \rightarrow 1; fixed output token, varying triggers → \rightarrow 2; fixed trigger, varying output → \rightarrow 6. 3. **13 vs 17 vs 20/12 (where does the answer come from?)** present in the context → \rightarrow 13; from knowledge, changes with the question → \rightarrow 17; the word is split mid-token and completed by orthography → \rightarrow 20 (proper noun) or 12 (common word). Order when several fit: 3 (removed-column test), then the domain labels 15 (anything inside source or markup, incl. its whitespace), 8, 10, 21, 9, 20, 12, 11, 14, 13, 17; then grammar 5 over 4; then the lexical ladder 1 → \rightarrow 2 → \rightarrow 6 → \rightarrow 7; then 18; then 19 (only if no trigger family motivates the token); then 22 (only if the outputs are neither completions nor complements of the trigger); 0 only when nothing fits. 16 is primary only for language-specific mechanisms (see its row); otherwise it is a secondary. Expected base rates from the hand review of 1,378 communities: 19 and 22 are each about 5% and 1.5% of communities; if either exceeds ˜10% of a batch, the tests above are being applied too loosely. blocks.en: You classify a "neuron community" of Llama-3.1-8B by the FUNCTION it performs at the next-token prediction it controls. You get the community’s size and layers and up to 100 real examples: the text before the target (ending where the model predicts the next token), the actual next token, the model’s top predictions with probabilities, and the top predictions after the community’s neurons are removed at that position ("removed"). The community is causally necessary and sufficient on these examples. Look at what changes between the intact and removed predictions, not at the topic of the text.

blocks.en: Assign exactly one PRIMARY label (the number), an optional SECONDARY label when a second reading is genuinely plausible, and a short lowercase FUNCTION slug naming the mechanism so that identical mechanisms get identical slugs across communities.

blocks.zh: 洛杉矶

blocks.en: 1 fixed phrase / collocation — one lexical trigger completes ONE fixed multiword expression or idiom tail ("each other", "from time to time", "take into account", "on behalf of"). *The completed string is the same across examples.*
blocks.zh: 1个固定短语 /同位相通——一个词典触发器完成 ONE 固定多字表达式或相通尾("每一个","不时","考虑","代表"). * 已完成的字符串在实例上是一样的。 * 联合国

blocks.en: 2 specific token promoted after a trigger family — one output token promoted after a family of related triggers (" of" after ability/protection, " in" after increase/rise, "along" after come/happen, "exhibit" in museum contexts). *Same output token, different triggers, and the trigger motivates it.*
blocks.zh: 2个在触发家族后被推广的具体标志——一个在关联触发家族后被推广的输出标志(""在能力/保护后被","在"在增加/起后被","来后被"/"出","出"在博物馆背景中被推广). *相同的输出符,不同的触发器,而触发器则激发它. * 联合国

blocks.en: 3 suppression of a default word — the community holds down one ordinary, topically plausible word or word family; when it is removed the prediction collapses onto that word in nearly every example, even where it is wrong (salt, budget, trust, bacteria, engine, wise, cup). *Look at the REMOVED column: it repeats one token at 0.6–1.0 across unrelated contexts.*
blocks.zh: 3 压制默认单词——社区按住一个普通的,主题上可行的单词或单词家族;当它被删除时,几乎每一个例子都会在这个词上崩溃,即使它是错误的(盐,预算,信任,细菌,引擎,智慧,杯子). * 看看删除的一栏:在不相关上下文中,它以0.6-1.0重复一个符号。 * 联合国

blocks.en: 4 local grammar (closed-set choice) — syntactic choice decided by adjacent words: a/an, there is/are, do-support, subject–auxiliary inversion, article after a preposition, which/that, imperative after a fronted clause. *Antecedent is within a few tokens.*
blocks.zh: 4个本地语法(封闭-设置选择)——由相邻词决定的协同选择:a/an,有/有,do-support,subject-Assoliary inversion,文章先作一前置后置后置,在前置条款后即为必要. * 先例在几个标志之内。 * 联合国

blocks.en: 5 long-range agreement / anaphora — form fixed by an earlier noun phrase or discourse referent: pronoun case/gender/number, possessive determiners (your/their/his), reflexives, copula number with an inverted or distant subject, VP-ellipsis auxiliary echo, polarity items licensed a clause earlier. *Antecedent is a sentence or more away.*
blocks.zh: 5 长距离协议 / aaphora ——由更早的名词短语或语句所固定的形式:代名词案例/性别/数字,占有性确定者(你/他们/他),反射性,带有倒数或远数主体的相接号,VP-椭圆形辅助回声,极性项目在更早时许可了一条条款. * "前序"是句子或更远. * 联合国

blocks.en: 6 trigger lemma selects its complement — one recurring trigger word or lemma, several acceptable continuations chosen by local context: verb/noun argument structure (demand → \rightarrow of/for/to; "within" → \rightarrow the/a/weeks), sense-dependent continuation of a polysemous word (bank, interest, stress), compound heads after a fixed modifier (full-, run-). *Same trigger, output token varies.*
blocks.zh: 6 触发 lemma 选择其补充——一个反复出现的触发词或lemma,由本地上下文选择的几种可接受的续作: 动词/名词参数结构(需求 →\rightarrow of/ for/to;"内部" →\rightarrow the/a/weeks),多相声词(银行,兴趣,应力)的依赖感续作,固定修饰后复作头(完整-,运行-). *相同的触发器,输出符号不同. * 联合国

blocks.en: 7 semantic content word / near-synonym choice — a specific content word required by sentence meaning, or the choice among a small set of near-synonyms for one role (" World" before War, "dedicated" for a church, victim/subject/target, end/goal/aim). *One lemma or one semantic role per community; the word is demanded, not merely on-topic.*
blocks.zh: 7个语义内容单词 / 近同义词选择——句子意义要求的具体内容单词,或选取一小组近同义词中的一个角色("战前的世界","专门"一个教会,被害者/被害者/被害者/被害者,终点/目标/aim). *每个社区一个lemma或一个语义角色;这个词是需要的,而不仅仅是主题上的. * 联合国

blocks.en: 8 number / arithmetic / units — computed or scale-dependent numeric output: ordinal suffix from digits, digit continuation to the right precision, base conversion, exponent/sign continuation, Roman numerals, unit of the right magnitude, era markers, multiplicative comparison
blocks.zh: 8个数字 / 算术 / 单位 —— 计算或尺度依赖的数字输出:从数字到数字的正数后缀,从数字继续到正确的精度,基数转换,符号/符号续作,罗马数字,正数的单位,时代标记,多相比较

blocks.en: 9 punctuation / delimiter / layout in prose — delimiter and layout tokens in ordinary text: closing parenthesis/quote balance, what follows an opening bracket, resuming a clause after a parenthetical, list commas and dashes, em-dash continuation, periods after abbreviations, en dash vs hyphen in ranges, casing style
